content: Nohinaehare, Jesus koamaniya tyaohenerenae, Enore haomana aohenerenae: Maika Jesus tahi waiye xahekotya. Enore axikahetene kalorexe sacerdote tyaona maheta hoka wiso tyakekohenerenae kahinaetyase tyaona maheta.
Hiyaiya, Enore aokitereharenae taita tyoma, nikare ehatene aoka hoka, Moisés tyotya tyomehenere Enore hanako akereta.
Xala xamani atyo tyoma hati hoka háomane xahehare atyo kaxaiminisaka. Nikare tehitiya Jesus masakare waiye xaiminisaka Moisés xahe.
Tyotya hatinae atyo kaomasexe taita hoka Enore atyo tyotya xoalini hare nomasehare.
Moisés tyotya Enore aokiterehare taita tyoma ehanako. Wakahare waiyexe hoka xoalini hare irae Enore jikiniti irae aokowitereharenae tahi.
Hoka Cristo atyo Enore Ityani hoka waiye kaxaikota Hanexe hana. Wisaonaiya ekoamaniya, wityakekone, wikinatere harenaeya ekoamaniya wisaona hoka ehanaiya wisaona.
Hiyeta hoka Isekohaliti Waiyexe exakere irae:

content.text: awa atyo ximasemaxemalahare xisaona xahetakomaniyereharenae akereta. Ehareha ihiye hoka maharexakahare nali hasakaharehenaherene xowaka akere.
Hoka Enore nexa: “Xahetakomaniyereharenae hasakaharetya natyo. 40-terehokoane xoalini hare notyomehenere xakore tyotya waiyaha hoka.
Hiyeta nehare ihiyeha hoka nomi: ‘Exe halitinae atyo maisa waiyexe, maisa nawenanyaho kakoa waiyoretaha’.
Nehare hoka nomi: ‘Maisaiya xoana xowaka ewaikoheraha naohenere nali kaokahitaha hoka kawinahitaha nokakoi’ ”.

content: Nohinaeharenae, xiriharira xawenane kakoa, waiya aliya hoka iniyalahare xahekotya hoka ximatyakekone hiyeta maisa Enore makamanehare koamaniya xisaohitita.

Maika xaihalahalinikisa kakoa, “kalikini” wisaonitatere xowaka, Iraiti Waiyexe nanekoa iraetere akereta. Nikare xisaona hoka maisa xalahare xinekonitare kamaoseratyakita iniyalahare hiyeta, exahe hoka maisa ximasemaxemalahare xisaona.
Hiyaiya, hetati wityakekohenere Cristo aosetaiya heko wikinatere wityakekone hoka imiyanaose kijiyaiya xane hikoahena hoka ihinaehare kaiserehareya wisaona.
Exakere atyo Iraiti Waiyexe nanekoa nexa:

content.text: Kalikiniya xasema Enore niraene hoka awa atyo ximasemaxemalahare xisaona xahetakomaniyereharenae, eharehenahere ihiye xowaka akere.

content: Xala Enore niraene sema hoka ehare ihiye? Moisés tyotya nolohetehenerenae Egito nalita.
Xalanae hiye Enore ehare 40-terehokoane? Iniyalahare tyoma hoka wainihenerenae maharexakahare hiye.

Xala tahi Enore exakere irae, hairaene akereta tyoma aokowihenere xowaka: “Maisa ite xoana xowaka ewaikoheraha naohenere nali kaokahitaha hoka kawinahitaha nokakoi”. Masemaxemarehenerenae tahi exakere iraeta.
Waiyekahalaka atyo womana: Hamatyakekoneneha hiyetaiya maisa aliyakere Enore ewaikoheraha aohenere nali kaokahitaha.
